CreateCheckRun.summary: Creates a check run record only.

schema.title: A short description of struct
schema.description: The organization ID. You can get the organization ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}
The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you use an AccessKey or STS temporary authorization for authentication.

The request body.

name.description:
The name of the check run.

> The name must be unique for a given repository, commit ID, and author. The maximum length is 50 characters.

headSha.description:
The commit SHA.

> This commit must be at the head of a branch that is the source of a merge request.

status.description:
The status of the check run. Valid values:

- `queued`: Queued

- `in_progress`: In progress

- `completed`: Completed

conclusion.description:
The conclusion of the check run. Valid values:

- `cancelled`: Cancelled

- `failure`: Failure

- `neutral`: Neutral. This is a success state.

- `success`: Success

- `skipped`: Skipped. This is a success state.

- `timed_out`: Timed out

startedAt.description:
The time the check run started.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z.

completedAt.description:
The time the check run completed.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z.

externalId.description:
The ID from an external system.

> An external system refers to your own check system. Use this field to store an identifier from that system. The platform stores this value as a string and does not interpret it.

detailsUrl.description: The URL to a page on an external system with full details about the check run. The platform provides a link to this URL.

output.description: The display information for the check run.

title.description: The title of the UI module. This is different from the check run 'name'.

summary.description:
A summary of the check run.

> Supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB).

text.description:
The details of the check run.

> Supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB).

images.description:
An array of image objects.

caption.description: A short description of the image.

annotations.description:

startLine.description:

CreatePipeline.summary: Creates a pipeline based on a YAML definition.

schema.description: The ID of the organization. You can find this ID in the organization URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
The name of the pipeline.
The pipeline definition in YAML format. For syntax details, see https\://help.aliyun.com/document\_detail/2249317.html.
schema.example:
sources:                                                  # sources 配置流水线源节点
  my_repo:                                                # 流水线源唯一标识 id
    type: codeup                                          # 流水线源类型
    name: 代码源名称                                       # 代码源的展示名称            
    endpoint: <your-codeup-repository-url>                # 代码源的 url
    branch: master                                        # 代码源的默认分支
    triggerEvents: push                                    # 代码源监听事件
    certificate:                                          # certificate 认证信息
      type: serviceConnection                              # 认证类型为服务连接
      serviceConnection: <your-service-connection-id>      # 服务连接 id
stages:                                       # stages 配置流水线阶段
  build_stage:                                # 流水线阶段标识 id
    name: 构建阶段                             # 流水线阶段的展示名称
    jobs:                                     # jobs 配置流水线任务
      build_job:                              # 流水线任务标识 id
        name: 构建任务                         # 流水线任务的展示名称
        runsOn: public/cn-beijing             # 流水线任务运行的集群环境
        steps:                                # steps 配置流水线步骤
          build_step:                         # 流水线步骤标识 id
            step: JavaBuild                   # 选择执行步骤
            name: java构建                     # 流水线执行步骤的展示名称
            with:                             # 步骤的参数
              run: |
                mvn -B clean package -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Dautoconfig.skip
          upload_step:
            step: ArtifactUpload
            name: 构建物上传
            with:
              uploadType: flowPublic
              artifact: default
              filePath:
                - target/
                - deploy.sh
  deploy_stage:
    name: 部署阶段
    jobs:
      deploy_job:
        name: 主机组部署任务
        component: VMDeploy                # 选择执行组件
        with:                              # 执行组件的参数
          artifact: $[stages.build_stage.build_job.upload_step.artifacts.default]
          machineGroup: <your-machine-group-id>
          artifactDownloadPath: /home/admin/app/package.tgz
          executeUser: root
          run: |
            mkdir -p /home/admin/application/
            tar zxvf /home/admin/app/package.tgz -C /home/admin/application/
            sh /home/admin/application/deploy.sh restart

success.description: Indicates whether the API call was successful.

result.description: The result of the API call.

createdAt.description: The time the commit was created.

authorEmail.description: The email address of the author.

authoredDate.description: The time the commit was authored.

committerEmail.description: The email address of the committer.

committedDate.description: The time the commit was committed.

gpgKeyId.description: The ID of the GPG key for the signature.

verificationStatus.description:
The GPG verification status.

- `unverified`: The signature is not verified.

- `verified`: The GPG public key is verified, and the committer's email address matches the email address in the key.

- `same_user_different_email`: The GPG public key is verified, and the committer's email address belongs to the current user, but it does not match the email address in the key.

- `other_user`: The GPG public key is verified, but the committer's email address does not belong to the key owner.

- `unverified_key`: The email address in the key is not in the user's list of verified email addresses.

- `unknown_key`: The GPG key does not exist.

This API retrieves the metadata needed to upload a file as a work item attachment. It is the first of three steps:\
1\. Call this API to get the upload information.\
2\. Use the information in the response to upload the file to Object Storage Service (OSS).\
3\. Call the `WorkitemAttachmentCreate` API to associate the uploaded file with the work item.\
\
For step 2, refer to the OSS documentation at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html. The request must use the `POST` method and be submitted as a form.\
\
\
\
\

schema.title: A short description of struct
schema.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain it from the URL of your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization page, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}`.

The ID or full path of the repository.
The ID of the check run.

name.description: The name of the check run.

startedAt.description:
The time when the check run started.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. For example, `2023-03-15T08:00:00Z`.

completedAt.description:
The time when the check run completed.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. For example, `2023-03-15T08:00:00Z`.

externalId.description:
The ID from an external system.

> This ID comes from your external check system. You can specify any string as the ID, and the platform stores it as a string.

detailsUrl.description: The URL of a page with more details about the check run. The platform will link to this URL.

status.description:
The current status of the check run. Valid values:

- `queued`: The check run is queued.

- `in_progress`: The check run is in progress.

- `completed`: The check run is completed.

conclusion.description:
The final conclusion of the check run. This parameter is required if `status` is set to `completed`. Valid values:

- `cancelled`: The check run was canceled.

- `failure`: The check run failed.

- `neutral`: The check run is neutral. This is treated as a success.

- `success`: The check run succeeded.

- `skipped`: The check run was skipped. This is treated as a success.

- `timed_out`: The check run timed out.

output.description: Contains output to display on the check run page.

title.description: The title of the UI module. This is different from the `name` parameter.

summary.description:
A short summary of the check run.

> This field supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB).

text.description:
The detailed information about the check run.

> This field supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB).

images.description:
A list of image objects to display in the output.

> A check run can display images in the output module.

items.description: An object containing information for a single image.

alt.description: The alternative text for the image.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the image. The URL must be publicly accessible, or the image will not be displayed.

caption.description: A short description of the image.

annotations.description:
A list of annotations.

> - You can display code quality results from third-party systems as annotations on the check run.
>
> - This field is append-only during updates. To avoid duplicates, do not resubmit existing annotations.

items.description: An object representing a single annotation.

path.description: The path of the file to which the annotation applies.

startLine.description:
The start line of the annotation.

> Line numbering starts at 1. Ensure the line number is valid for the specified file; otherwise, the annotation will not be displayed.

endLine.description: The end line of the annotation.

startColumn.description:
The start column of the annotation.

> This parameter is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`.

endColumn.description:
The end column of the annotation.

> This parameter is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`.

annotationLevel.description:
The level of the annotation. Valid values:

- `notice`: A minor issue.

- `warning`: Warning.

- `failure`: A severe issue.

message.description: A short description of the annotation.

UpdatePipeline.summary: This operation updates only YAML-based pipelines.

schema.description: The unique identifier of the organization. You can get this ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
The name of the pipeline.
The definition of the pipeline in YAML format. For more information about how to write the YAML content, see https\://help.aliyun.com/document\_detail/2249317.html.
schema.example:
sources:                                                  # sources 配置流水线源节点
  my_repo:                                                # 流水线源唯一标识 id
    type: codeup                                          # 流水线源类型
    name: 代码源名称                                       # 代码源的展示名称            
    endpoint: <your-codeup-repository-url>                # 代码源的 url
    branch: master                                        # 代码源的默认分支
    triggerEvents: push                                    # 代码源监听事件
    certificate:                                          # certificate 认证信息
      type: serviceConnection                              # 认证类型为服务连接
      serviceConnection: <your-service-connection-id>      # 服务连接 id
stages:                                       # stages 配置流水线阶段
  build_stage:                                # 流水线阶段标识 id
    name: 构建阶段                             # 流水线阶段的展示名称
    jobs:                                     # jobs 配置流水线任务
      build_job:                              # 流水线任务标识 id
        name: 构建任务                         # 流水线任务的展示名称
        runsOn: public/cn-beijing             # 流水线任务运行的集群环境
        steps:                                # steps 配置流水线步骤
          build_step:                         # 流水线步骤标识 id
            step: JavaBuild                   # 选择执行步骤
            name: java构建                     # 流水线执行步骤的展示名称
            with:                             # 步骤的参数
              run: |
                mvn -B clean package -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Dautoconfig.skip
          upload_step:
            step: ArtifactUpload
            name: 构建物上传
            with:
              uploadType: flowPublic
              artifact: default
              filePath:
                - target/
                - deploy.sh
  deploy_stage:
    name: 部署阶段
    jobs:
      deploy_job:
        name: 主机组部署任务
        component: VMDeploy                # 选择执行组件
        with:                              # 执行组件的参数
          artifact: $[stages.build_stage.build_job.upload_step.artifacts.default]
          machineGroup: <your-machine-group-id>
          artifactDownloadPath: /home/admin/app/package.tgz
          executeUser: root
          run: |
            mkdir -p /home/admin/application/
            tar zxvf /home/admin/app/package.tgz -C /home/admin/application/
            sh /home/admin/application/deploy.sh restart
